taxonomy.subtopic: Intimal tear, false lumen, and dynamic branch-vessel obstruction

entries.learning_objective: Recognize that acute aortic dissection can cause organ ischemia through dynamic obstruction by an intimal flap, even without a fixed thrombus in the affected branch artery.

taxonomy.subtopic: Light criteria and diuretic-associated pseudoexudate

entries.learning_objective: Explain why heart-failure effusions may become pseudoexudates after diuresis and use the serum-to-pleural albumin gradient to recover the underlying transudative physiology.

taxonomy.subtopic: Diffuse alveolar damage and hyaline membranes

entries.learning_objective: Identify diffuse alveolar damage as the morphologic substrate of ARDS and connect barrier disruption to protein-rich edema, hyaline membranes, low compliance, and refractory hypoxemia.

taxonomy.subtopic: Retrograde blood supply and proximal-pole avascular necrosis

entries.learning_objective: Use the scaphoid's retrograde vascular anatomy to predict proximal-pole avascular necrosis after a waist fracture, even when initial radiographs are normal.

taxonomy.subtopic: Urease, alkaline urine, and staghorn magnesium ammonium phosphate

entries.learning_objective: Link urease-positive urinary infection to ammonia production, alkaline urine, coffin-lid crystals, and staghorn struvite calculi.

taxonomy.subtopic: MYC translocation and high-proliferation starry-sky pattern

entries.learning_objective: Recognize Burkitt lymphoma from rapid growth, starry-sky histology, and very high Ki-67, and connect it to immunoglobulin-enhancer-driven MYC overexpression.

taxonomy.subtopic: PML-RARA differentiation block, DIC, and all-trans retinoic acid

entries.learning_objective: Identify APL as a coagulopathic emergency and explain how all-trans retinoic acid reverses the PML-RARA-mediated block in myeloid differentiation.

taxonomy.subtopic: Misfolded immunoglobulin light chains and Congo-red-positive fibrils

entries.learning_objective: Differentiate AL amyloidosis from AA, transthyretin, dialysis-related, and localized amyloid by linking the clinical context to the fibril precursor.

taxonomy.subtopic: PfEMP1-mediated cytoadherence and microvascular sequestration

entries.learning_objective: Explain severe falciparum malaria through infected-erythrocyte cytoadherence, rosetting, and microvascular sequestration rather than hypnozoite relapse.

taxonomy.subtopic: Hepatic first-pass metabolism and serotonin-mediated right-sided fibrosis

entries.learning_objective: Connect the onset of carcinoid syndrome from a gastrointestinal primary to hepatic metastasis, loss of first-pass metabolism, and preferential right-sided valvular fibrosis.

taxonomy.subtopic: Primary-cilium signaling and intracranial saccular aneurysm association

entries.learning_objective: Recognize the major extrarenal manifestations of ADPKD, including hepatic cysts and intracranial saccular aneurysms, and identify family history as an important risk signal.

taxonomy.subtopic: Preoperative alpha blockade before beta blockade

entries.learning_objective: Apply the required preoperative sequence for pheochromocytoma: alpha blockade and volume expansion first, followed by beta blockade only when needed.

taxonomy.subtopic: Reactivation of latent tissue cysts in advanced HIV

entries.learning_objective: Distinguish cerebral toxoplasmosis from other HIV-associated neurologic diseases by recognizing reactivation, multiple ring-enhancing basal-ganglia lesions, and severe CD4 depletion.

taxonomy.subtopic: Persistent cystic-duct obstruction and gallbladder inflammation

entries.learning_objective: Differentiate acute calculous cholecystitis from biliary colic and cholangitis by identifying persistent cystic-duct obstruction, gallbladder inflammation, and characteristic ultrasound findings.

taxonomy.subtopic: Reduced beta-globin synthesis and ineffective erythropoiesis

entries.learning_objective: Explain beta-thalassemia anemia through globin-chain imbalance, alpha-chain precipitation, ineffective erythropoiesis, and the characteristic electrophoresis pattern.

taxonomy.subtopic: Abnormal spiral-artery remodeling and antiangiogenic endothelial injury

entries.learning_objective: Trace preeclampsia from defective spiral-artery remodeling to placental ischemia, sFlt-1 excess, systemic endothelial dysfunction, hypertension, and proteinuria.

taxonomy.subtopic: Immune-mediated hematopoietic stem-cell destruction

entries.learning_objective: Identify aplastic anemia as a production failure caused commonly by immune attack on hematopoietic stem cells, producing pancytopenia, low reticulocytes, and a hypocellular fatty marrow.

taxonomy.subtopic: Plasma-cell-rich endarteritis caused by Treponema pallidum

entries.learning_objective: Recognize the painless primary chancre and connect syphilitic tissue injury to plasma-cell-rich inflammation and obliterative endarteritis.

taxonomy.subtopic: Fixed splitting of S2 from chronic right-sided volume loading

entries.learning_objective: Explain fixed splitting of S2 in ASD through chronic right-sided volume overload and respiratory counterbalancing of systemic venous return and shunt flow.

taxonomy.subtopic: Diastolic backflow, wide pulse pressure, and loss of isovolumetric phases

entries.learning_objective: Relate aortic regurgitation to wide pulse pressure, increased left ventricular end-diastolic volume, and loss of normal isovolumetric phases on the pressure-volume loop.
